Name: Male Fertility Dance
Author: CorvusSDV
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is meant as an adjunct to bezejel's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34324]Spring Fertility Dance.[/url][/color]

In that mod at the climax (heh) of the Flower Festival dance the ladies raise
their dresses to display their nethers.  This is the other side: The gents
drop trou to display their wedding tackle to the ladies.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip and move the Male Fertility Dance folder into the game's Mod folder.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Vanilla NPC bachelors only.  There is no change for the Farmer who 
successfully asks someone to dance.

The bachelorettes get an eyeful but what we get is mainly bachelor bums.
Shane can keep his boxer shorts on.

Note: In the SFD pic above I used slightly modifies sprites of the girls.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Spring Fertility Dance not really required but where's the fun in that?[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]bezejel who thought of the rite in the first place.[/color]
